QuestInfo.name: Keep It Secret!
QuestInfo.0: Criminals always returned to the scene of the crime. Alpha and Beta decided to wait at the pharmacy for Mu Tan to return.
QuestInfo.1: Mu Tan confesses to his crime and begs that you don't turn him into No Gong since he has learned his lesson. You feel bad for Mu Tan yet you have made a promise to No Gong. What is the right decision here?
QuestInfo.2: Mu Tan admitted to eating the meat, but begged Alpha and Beta to keep it a secret, so he wouldn't get kicked from the dojo.

0.0: If No gong finds out I had meat, he'll force me out of training... I really have nowhere else to go... Could you keep this a secret? Just this once?

yes.0: Thank you SO much! I would've been out on the streets if it wasn't for you! I won't even even LOOK at meat, ever again!

default.0: It's a secret that I'm the culprit, okay?
